anomalies.evidence: Interval O113:O150 divides AHT Session by 63; total O151 divides by 60.
Interval AB113:AB150 uses direct Scheduled/Required division while the total AB151 uses IFERROR.
Interval F113:F121 uses a plain SUM that returns zero, while F122:F150 wraps the same shifted SUM pattern to return blank when the result is zero.
The WB0817 binary contains 1,885 cached errors; exact types and sheet locations are in the formula catalog.
Defined names LOB and sst resolve to #REF!, and Teams Update contains broken reference operands; the owner accepts these as legacy behavior for parity.

Five core WB0817 source-to-interval formula families floor raw timestamp hours directly without a GMT-to-PST offset. The only negative constant time shift is Teams Update F8:F16 (-15 hours), a downstream report-support calculation with no path into Interval View source bucketing.
Representative raw exports stop around 10:00-10:14, while WB0817 cached source tables extend to approximately 21:54-23:18 and contain materially more rows.
